comps.name: chi_squared_binning
comps.desc: Generate chi-squared binning rules for individual datasets.

attrs.name: max_bin_num
attrs.desc: Max bin counts for one feature. If provided, threshold will be ignored.

attrs.name: threshold
attrs.desc: threshold to merge neighbouring groups. If provided, max_bin_num will be ignored.

attrs.name: positive_label
attrs.desc: Which value represent positive value in label.

comps.name: chi_squared_substitution
comps.desc: Substitute datasets' cols by equal chi-squared binning substitution rules.

comps.name: equal_frequency_binning
comps.desc: Generate equal frequency binning rules for individual datasets.

comps.name: equal_frequency_substitution
comps.desc: Substitute datasets' cols by equal frequency binning substitution rules.

comps.name: equal_width_binning
comps.desc: Generate equal width binning rules for individual datasets.

comps.name: equal_width_substitution
comps.desc: Substitute datasets' cols by equal width binning substitution rules.

comps.name: fillna
comps.desc: Fill na of a col.

attrs.name: strategy
attrs.desc: The strategy to fill NA. For string cols, only mode and constant options are allowed. If constant is selected, the corresponding constant value should be provided as well.

attrs.name: constant_float
attrs.desc: Only valid when selected col is float and strategy is constant.

attrs.name: constant_int64
attrs.desc: Only valid when selected col is int64 and strategy is constant.

attrs.name: constant_bool
attrs.desc: Only valid when selected col is bool and strategy is constant.

attrs.name: constant_str
attrs.desc: Only valid when selected col is str and strategy is constant.

comps.name: normalization
comps.desc: Normalize cols.

attrs.name: strategies
attrs.desc: The strategy to normalize. standard: Standardize features by removing the mean and scaling to unit variance. max_abs: Scale each feature by its maximum absolute value. min_max: Transform features by scaling each feature to a given range.

attrs.name: cols
attrs.desc: Column(s) to normalize. Only numeric column(s) are allowed.

comps.name: onehot_encode
comps.desc: Generate One Hot binning rules for individual datasets.

comps.name: onehot_substitution
comps.desc: Substitute datasets' cols by onehot substitution rules.

comps.name: sql_executor
comps.desc: Execute SQL on a table. NOTE: the table name is fixed to input_table. The last SQL must be SELECT statements.

attrs.name: statements
attrs.desc: SQL statements. Only supports sqlite. The table name is fixed to be input_table. The last statement must be SELECT statement.

comps.name: woe_binning
comps.desc: Generate Weight of Evidence (WOE) binning rules for individual datasets.

attrs.name: binning_method
attrs.desc: How to bin features with numeric types: quantile"(equal frequency)/"bucket"(equal width)

attrs.name: positive_label
attrs.desc: Which value represent positive value in label.

attrs.name: bin_num
attrs.desc: Max bin counts for one features.

comps.name: woe_substitution
comps.desc: Substitute datasets' value by WOE substitution rules.

comps.name: biclassification_eval
comps.desc:
Statistics evaluation for a bi-classification model on a dataset.
1. summary_report: SummaryReport
2. eq_frequent_bin_report: List[EqBinReport]
3. eq_range_bin_report: List[EqBinReport]
4. head_report: List[PrReport]
reports for fpr = 0.001, 0.005, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2

attrs.name: min_item_cnt_per_bucket
attrs.desc: Min item cnt per bucket. If any bucket doesn't meet the requirement, error raises. For security reasons, we require this parameter to be at least 2.

comps.name: multiclass_classification_eval
comps.desc: Statistics evaluation for a multi-class classification model on a dataset.

attrs.name: label
attrs.desc: The column of label. The value type must be int or string.

attrs.name: scores
attrs.desc: The column(s) of score. Please make sure the order must aligned with that of classes.

comps.name: prediction_bias_eval
comps.desc: Calculate prediction bias, ie. average of predictions - average of labels.

attrs.name: min_item_cnt_per_bucket
attrs.desc: Min item cnt per bucket. If any bucket doesn't meet the requirement, error raises. For security reasons, we require this parameter to be at least 2.

comps.name: lgbm_train
comps.desc: LightGBM train component for individual dataset.

attrs.name: n_estimators
attrs.desc: Number of boosted trees to fit.

attrs.name: num_leaves
attrs.desc: Max number of leaves in one tree.

attrs.name: ids
attrs.desc: Id columns will not be trained.

comps.name: lr_train
comps.desc: linear or logistic regression training.

attrs.name: max_iter
attrs.desc: Maximum number of iterations taken for the solvers to converge.

attrs.name: penalty
attrs.desc: The penalty(aka regularization term) to be used.

attrs.name: ids
attrs.desc: Id columns will not be trained.

comps.name: xgb_train
comps.desc: Provides both classification and regression tree boosting (also known as GBDT, GBM) for individual dataset.

attrs.name: max_leaves
attrs.desc: Maximum leaf of a tree. 0 indicates no limit.

attrs.name: learning_rate
attrs.desc: Step size shrinkage used in update to prevent overfitting.

attrs.name: gamma
attrs.desc: Greater than 0 means pre-pruning enabled. If gain of a node is less than this value, it would be pruned.

attrs.name: colsample_bytree
attrs.desc: Subsample ratio of columns when constructing each tree.

attrs.name: base_score
attrs.desc: The initial prediction score of all instances, global bias.

attrs.name: min_child_weight
attrs.desc: Minimum sum of instance weight (hessian) needed in a child. If the tree partition step results in a leaf node with the sum of instance weight less than min_child_weight, then the building process will give up further partitioning

attrs.name: alpha
attrs.desc: L1 regularization term on weights. Increasing this value will make model more conservative

attrs.name: subsample
attrs.desc: Subsample ratio of the training instance.

attrs.name: max_bin
attrs.desc: Maximum number of discrete bins to bucket continuous features.  Only used if tree_method is set to hist, approx or gpu_hist.

attrs.name: tree_method
attrs.desc: The tree construction algorithm used in XGBoost.

attrs.name: ids
attrs.desc: Id columns will not be trained.

comps.name: union

outputs.name: report
outputs.desc: Output Pearson's product-moment correlation coefficient report.

comps.name: table_statistics
comps.desc:
Get a table of statistics,
including each column's
1. datatype
2. total_count
3. count
4. count_na
5. na_ratio
6. min
7. max
8. mean
9. var
10. std
11. sem
12. skewness
13. kurtosis
14. q1
15. q2
16. q3
17. moment_2
18. moment_3
19. moment_4
20. central_moment_2
21. central_moment_3
22. central_moment_4
23. sum
24. sum_2
25. sum_3
26. sum_4
- moment_2 means E[X^2].
- central_moment_2 means E[(X - mean(X))^2].
- sum_2 means sum(X^2).

attrs.name: feature_selects
attrs.desc: Specify which features to calculate VIF with. If empty, all features will be used.
